projects.title: Self-Healing Mesh Radio Network
projects.summary: A solar-powered LoRa mesh network designed to keep emergency communications working when individual nodes fail.
projects.description: Engineered a decentralized mesh network using ESP32 microcontrollers and LoRa. Implemented Dijkstra-based routing for automatic fault recovery, AES-128 encryption for GPS and environmental telemetry, and a web dashboard for network status and emergency alerts.

projects.title: RoboVision: Autonomous Obstacle Detection
projects.summary: An autonomous robot combining real-time object detection with ultrasonic sensing and emergency braking.
projects.description: Developed a dual-compute autonomous vehicle using YOLOv8n and OpenCV to detect 12 obstacle classes. Added a 10 Hz ultrasonic sensing system with emergency braking within 18 cm and servo-driven camera panning.

projects.title: AI & Machine Learning Models
projects.summary: A collection of machine learning and NLP experiments, including a heart disease classifier served through a Flask application.
projects.description: Built predictive models across multiple domains using Scikit-learn and TF-IDF vectorization. Deployed a heart disease classification model in a Flask web application for interactive predictions.

blog_posts.title: Building Across Backend, AI, and Connected Systems
blog_posts.content:
# Building Across Backend, AI, and Connected Systems

My work spans backend engineering, applied machine learning, computer vision, and embedded systems. The common thread is turning technical ideas into systems people can use.

## Building dependable software

At Telite Systems, I contribute to a multi-tenant Learning Management System. I work across FastAPI and PostgreSQL services, React interfaces, Docker-based environments, and GitHub Actions workflows. Working across those layers has taught me to follow a feature beyond the code: through integration, troubleshooting, and deployment.

## Exploring intelligent applications

My machine learning and computer vision projects include a Scikit-learn model served through Flask and a YOLOv8n/OpenCV obstacle detection robot. These projects have given me practical experience connecting model output to an application or physical system.

## Designing for unreliable environments

For a disaster-management mesh network, I explored ESP32 and LoRa communication, self-healing routing, encrypted telemetry, and a dashboard for network visibility. The project brought software, electronics, and resilience concerns together.

I am especially interested in backend and software engineering roles where I can keep learning, contribute across the stack, and build reliable products with a thoughtful team.
